title: Pizza With 3n Slices
goal: Choose the greatest total from one third of a circular pizza slices under the neighboring-removal rule.
strategy: The chosen slices can be modeled as a fixed-size nonadjacent selection on a cycle. An optimum excludes either the first or last slice; solve both linear fixed-count selections and take the better total.
